answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit ferrous bond with a quartz timer. It rusts 10 credits each idle epoch; only fresh signed work recoats it. A ripple of decay runs through the registry; anyone can recompute each bond from the quartz clock. 1,000 idle fakes lock 70,000 and burn 10,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool; a rented-refresher ring fails because the timer binds each log to its own key. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps it by working.
